en: A black‑and‑white riverside view showing a long, low paddle steamer named "PIRNA" moving along a calm river, its reflection clearly visible in the water. The steamer has an enclosed central cabin and open decks with passengers. On the opposite bank stand a few large houses, trees, terraced slopes and fields, and in the distance on the hilltop a church with a tall spire dominates a small town or village.
